title: ExtractorSnippet.v1
description: A small, sandboxed, deterministic extractor a bounded codegen agent DRAFTED to read a value out of a source (regex / json_path / html_selector / csv_field / markdown_heading / duration_parser / date_parser / numeric_parser / source_hash_checker). It is the load-bearing invariant of the whole foundry: produces is pinned to [fact_assertion_candidate] — an extractor's output is ALWAYS a FactAssertion CANDIDATE (claim_status=candidate) tied to a source_handle, NEVER served or canonical truth (red-team: produces='canonical_fact'/'fact' is rejected). It REQUIRES a source_handle (the candidate must be traceable to a source) and has_unit_test=true (no untested extractor; the snippet runs in a sandbox behind a proof gate before any use). Deterministic when created_at is injected.

snippet_id.description: content-addressed over (code_ref, extractor_type, fact_key); version in metadata, never in the id

fact_key.description: the fact this extractor produces a candidate for

language.description: what the code_ref is written in

code_ref.description: opaque ref to the snippet body in the object store — code is stored, not inlined, and is sandboxed before use

source_handle.description: REQUIRED — the candidate this extractor emits is tied to this source handle; an extractor that drops its source handle is rejected

produces.description: PINNED — an extractor ALWAYS produces a FactAssertion candidate, NEVER a served/canonical fact (red-team: 'canonical_fact'/'fact'/'served_fact' is rejected)

claim_status.description: PINNED candidate — the output's claim_status is always candidate until reconciliation/verification promote it elsewhere

has_unit_test.description: PINNED true — no extractor may be used without a unit test (the proof gate enforces a real, passing test)

unit_test_ref.description: opaque ref to the snippet's unit test (stored, runs in the sandbox)

sandbox_required.description: PINNED true — the snippet runs in a sandbox (temp dir, no secrets, no network unless the recipe allows) before any use

drafted_by.description: the codegen_agent_provider id that drafted this snippet (e.g. codegen.local_stub@v1) — agents draft, Baltor gates

high_risk.description: true triggers a human-approval hook before the snippet may be promoted to a worker
